name: AutoZone
description: AutoZone sells replacement car parts, maintenance items and accessories from 7,657 stores (6,627 US, 883 Mexico, 147 Brazil) to do-it-yourself owners and, increasingly, to repair shops (domestic commercial was 31.7 percent of US sales and grew 6.7 percent in FY2025). Roughly half of sales are failure parts a car needs when something breaks, which makes demand steady rather than fashion-driven. FY2025 sales were $18.9 billion with a 52.6 percent gross margin and about $3.6 billion of operating profit, and it has shrunk its share count by repurchases totalling $40.7 billion authorised since 1998 while paying no dividend. Since the fourth quarter of FY2025 it reports a single segment.

businessLines.how: Car owners buy parts at the counter when something fails or needs maintenance (high repeat visits, 52.6% gross margin company-wide); repair shops buy on account with fast delivery from hub stores, which grows faster than retail.
businessLines.description: US stores selling parts to car owners and delivering to repair shops (commercial programme)

businessLines.name: International (Mexico and Brazil)
